title: Telemetry erase handshake and safeguard
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement an idempotent, cross-region 'erase handshake' for telemetry records that coordinates quarantine, scrub, and final purge while preserving auditability. This ticket scopes the backend orchestrator (service + job workers + reconciliation) that: 1) accepts erase requests (customer or system-triggered), 2) places records into a quarantined epoch for scrub and verification, 3) runs an asynchronous handshake with downstream storage and analytic materialization layers to ensure effective tombstone application, and 4) emits a verifiable manifest for compliance attestation. The requirement is to avoid snapshotting whole clusters for erasure, minimize re-ingestion risk, and provide SLA-friendly completion signals for Console and Support.
acceptance_criteria: API endpoint accepts erase request and returns an erase_token and expected completion window
Quarantine queue stores per-customer epoch manifests and keeps original rowids for audit (masked in primary storage)
Workers run scrub rules (PII regex + schema-aware field redaction) and mark manifest entries as SCRUBBED/FAILED
Handshake ensures downstream systems (OLAP export, metrics pipeline, raw S3 replicas) acknowledge tombstone application or provide error details
Final manifest is archived (immutable) and contains attestations for each target system with checksums and timestamps
End-to-end integration tests cover idempotency (replay same erase token does not double-delete) and recovery from partial failures
technical_notes: Architecture: new EraseOrchestrator service backed by Kafka topic 'erase-epochs' + Dynamo-style metadata store for manifests
Epoch manifest format: epoch_id, customer_id, list[row_id_shards], scrub_rules_hash, started_at, expected_completion
Quarantine model: eviction TTL aligned to retention fencepost; records moved to S3 'quarantine/' prefix partitioned by epoch_id; metadata holds pointer
Handshake pattern: send FINISH message to each downstream consumer with epoch_id; consumer returns ACK/NAK with processing cursor; orchestrator retries with backoff
Trade-offs: strong consistency would require synchronous fanout and block callers—chose asynchronous handshake to meet Console latency SLOs at the cost of more complex reconciliation
Performance: batch deletes at 5k row_id shards per job; estimate throughput 50k records/min on staging GPU-less nodes; tune batch size based on queue latency
Security: manifests are signed with KMS-backed ephemeral key; access limited to compliance and SRE roles; ensure manifests do not contain raw PII (store only hashed row_id)
Observability: expose per-epoch metrics (started, scrubbed, acked, failed, retries) and tracing via x-request-id
tasks: Design schema for epoch manifests and quarantine S3 layout
Implement EraseOrchestrator service skeleton and API endpoints
Wire Kafka topic and manifest store; add producer/consumer contracts
Implement scrub worker with pluggable rules engine and unit tests
Implement handshake protocol and downstream consumer adapters (OLAP, metrics export, raw-replay service)
Add manifest signing and audit archive job
End-to-end integration tests and staging canary rollout
Create runbook for Support and Compliance including verification query patterns

2025-01-27 Marco Liu: Spike completed for manifest schema; opted to store hashed_row_ids instead of raw to reduce PII exposure. Prototype pushed to feature branch.
2025-02-03 Linnea Sørensen (SEC): Security review requested. Noted we must sign manifests and redact additional metadata fields. Added to tasks.
2025-02-07 Marco Liu: Early integration test failing when downstream consumer replays out-of-order; decided to add idempotent cursors and sequence checks on consumer side. Added TODO to adapters.

2025-02-13 QA: Staging run shows 98% success for handshake ack path under normal load; we hit a retry storm when a consumer returns transient 5xx. Plan: exponential backoff + jitter and circuit-breaker per consumer.
2025-02-19 PM review (Sofia Kramer): Requested clearer SLA signals for Console UI (erase_token states). Added API status field and estimated completion window to acceptance criteria.
